name: 10' Fabric Pop Up Display (Straight)
descriptionHtml:
https://displaytemplate.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/Fabric+Display/Velcro_Fabric_Pop_Up_Display_10ft_Straight.pdf

https://displaytemplate.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/Fabric+Display/Installation_Guide_-_Pop_Up_Display.pdf Hardcase Template

Installation Guide

Features:

Your artwork will be dye sublimated on polyester knit
Graphic panel covers the front and two sides of the display's frame; the back of the frame is not covered
Hook-and-loop fasteners make it easy to install graphic panels
Lightweight aluminum frame with nylon plastic hubs
Imprint Method: Full-Color Dye Sublimation
Single Sided Graphic

10ft Fabric Popup Includes:

  • (1) Single-Sided Dye-Sublimated Graphic (with Endcaps)
  • (1) Aluminum Frame
  • (1) Black Nylon Carry Bag

Features:

  • Display Size: 118"W x 89"H x 12"D
  • Template Size: 142.25"W x 88.5"H
  • Endcaps: 11.81" end panels on both sides
  • Material: Stretch Fabric
  • Shipping Dimensions: 14"L x 12"W x 32.75"H
  • Shipping Weight: 29 lbs
